execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."backlinks" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "linkedDocumentId" text NOT NULL,
  "sourceBlockId" text,
  "sourceDocumentId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."collection_items" (
  "collectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "order" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."collection_properties" (
  "collectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "config" json,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isVisible" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "order" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "width" int4,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."collection_values" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "itemId" text NOT NULL,
  "propertyId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "value" json,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."collection_views" (
  "collectionId" text NOT NULL,
  "config" json,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text DEFAULT '默认视图' NOT NULL,
  "order" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."collections" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "description" text,
  "folderId" text,
  "icon" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isDeleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text DEFAULT '未命名集合' NOT NULL,
  "order" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."comment_threads" (
  "blockId" text,
  "blockText" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "resolved" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."comments" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "threadId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."daily_notes_config" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "folderId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "startTime" text DEFAULT '00:00' NOT NULL,
  "templateId" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."document_shares" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isPublished" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "passcode" text,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."document_tags" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text NOT NULL,
  "tagId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("documentId", "tagId")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."document_versions" (
  "content" json NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "plainText" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 NOT NULL,
  "wordCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."documents" (
  "charCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "content" json,
  "coverImage" text,
  "coverType" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dailyNoteDate" timestamptz,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "folderId" text,
  "font" text,
  "icon" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isDailyNote" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "isDeleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "isTemplate" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "order" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "pageStyle" json,
  "parentId" text,
  "plainText" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "title" text DEFAULT '无标题' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "width" text,
  "wordCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."favorites" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "order" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."folders" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "icon" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isDeleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text DEFAULT '未命名文件夹' NOT NULL,
  "order" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "parentId" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tags" (
  "color" text DEFAULT '#6366f1' NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tasks" (
  "blockId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentId" text,
  "dueDate" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isCompleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "order" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'todo' NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "editorFont" text DEFAULT 'inter' NOT NULL,
  "editorWidth" text DEFAULT 'default' NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "image" text,
  "name" text,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "theme" text DEFAULT 'system' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."whiteboards" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" json,
  "deletedAt" timestamptz,
  "folderId" text,
  "icon" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isDeleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text DEFAULT '未命名白板' NOT NULL,
  "order" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
